COMWAY A33 Core Alignment Mini Fusion Splicing Machine

The COMWAY A33 Core Alignment Mini Fusion Splicing Machine is a compact yet powerful fiber splicer designed for high-precision splicing in various fiber optic applications. With its advanced PAS alignment technology, the A33 ensures accurate and low-loss splicing, making it an ideal choice for telecommunications, data centers, and fiber optic networks. Equipped with a 4.3-inch high-resolution touch screen, the A33 offers a user-friendly interface, allowing technicians to monitor and control splicing operations with ease. The machine supports a maximum of 100 splicing programs and can store up to 20,000 splicing records, ensuring efficient data management. Additionally, it features a high-speed USB port for seamless data transfer and software updates. One of the standout features of the COMWAY A33 is its fast and reliable splicing performance. It completes splicing in just 5 seconds under the SM Fast program and 12 seconds under the SM G652 program. The heating time is adjustable, with micro sleeves taking 8 seconds and standard 60mm sleeves taking 12 seconds. Designed for durability, the A33 operates in harsh environments, withstanding temperatures from -10°C to +50°C, humidity up to 95%, and wind speeds of up to 15m/s. It also features a high-capacity 4000mAh battery, providing over 240 splicing and heating cycles on a single charge, making it ideal for fieldwork. With a lightweight design (1.5kg without battery, 1.8kg with battery), the COMWAY A33 is highly portable. It supports various fiber types, including SM, MM, DS, NZDS, and BI fibers, ensuring versatility across different fiber optic installations. Overall, the COMWAY A33 Core Alignment Mini Fusion Splicing Machine is a high-performance, efficient, and durable solution for fiber optic professionals looking for precision, reliability, and ease of use.

Features of COMWAY A33 Core Alignment Mini Fusion Splicing Machine

  • High-Precision Core Alignment – Utilizes PAS (Profile Alignment System) technology for highly accurate and low-loss fiber splicing.
  • Fast Splicing & Heating – 5-second splicing (SM Fast program) and 12-second heating for efficient workflow.
  • Large Storage Capacity – Stores up to 20,000 splicing records and 800 splice images for easy data tracking.
  • Advanced Magnification – Features 500X (X/Y) zoom and 300X (X&Y) zoom, allowing precise fiber observation.
  • Versatile Fiber Compatibility – Supports SM (G.652), MM (G.651), DS (G.653), NZ/NZDS (G.655), and BI (G.657) fiber types.
  • Adjustable Heating Programs – Offers up to 30 heating programs for different fiber splicing needs.
  • Durable Battery Performance – 4000mAh high-capacity battery, supporting over 240 splicing and heating cycles on a single charge.
  • User-Friendly Interface – Equipped with a 4.3-inch high-resolution touch screen for easy operation.
  • Compact & Lightweight Design – Weighs only 1.5kg (1.8kg with battery), making it ideal for fieldwork.
  • Wide Operating Conditions – Functions efficiently in extreme conditions: -10°C to +50°C temperature, up to 95% humidity, and 5000m altitude.
  • Low Splicing Loss – Delivers exceptionally low splicing loss, ensuring reliable fiber connections:
  • SM: 0.02dB, MM: 0.01dB, DS: 0.04dB, NZ/NZDS: 0.04dB, BI: 0.02dB
  • Multiple Power Supply Options – Supports AC100-240V power input with an included adapter.
  • High-Speed USB Port – Enables data transfer, software updates, and connectivity with external devices.
  • Strong Wind & Environmental Resistance – Withstands wind speeds up to 15m/s, making it ideal for outdoor fiber splicing.
  • Electrode Durability – 5000 ARC discharges extend the machine’s lifespan and reduce maintenance costs.
